title: Document planned snapshots and release testing
summary: Docs now cover Planned Snapshot approval and repository release behavior, a local non-doc verification script is available, and tagged release builds inject the tag into eve version.
userVisibleChange: Maintainers can run scripts/local-test.sh for local non-doc verification, read Planned Snapshot docs in the docs site, and tagged releases now publish binaries whose reported version matches the release tag.

risks.title: The local script skips macOS approval app checks only when SKIP_MACOS_APPROVAL=1 is set; default macOS runs still depend on xcodebuild being installed.

decisions.title: Keep the npm package version at 0.0.0-development in git and inject the tagged release version during GitHub Actions deployment.
